in_sanskrit.name: इच्छा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The root word 'icch' in Sanskrit means 'to wish', 'to want'. The suffix 'a' adds the meaning of 'desire' or 'will'. So, Iccha means 'desire', 'will', or 'intention'.

in_marathi.name: Iccha
